QUOTE: "**Compile-time override (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` plus both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`)" and "Precedence: the compile-time macros win. `platform.c:16-19` says so, and it compiles out the runtime setter entirely in that case."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. It also says the macros win and compile out the runtime setter, so the two are mutually exclusive.
